name: TacJS Domain
description: Configures per-domain tarteaucitron.js (TacJS) consent services on multi-domain sites.
project_description:
This module integrates with the Drupal Domain module to let you configure Tarteaucitron services for each domain.

 Back to top 

 Versions 
 3.x 
 Requires TacJS 7+ and Domain 3+.

 This module is only required if you want to enable the feature that aggregates JavaScript from active Tarteaucitron services, reducing unnecessary script loading.

 2.x 
 Works with TacJS 6.x and Domain 2.x.
